task.subject: fix: show custom error message in prompt with hide_input=True

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/termui.py
+++ b/src/click/termui.py
@@ -203,7 +203,18 @@ def prompt(
             result = value_proc(value)
         except UsageError as e:
             if hide_input:
-                echo(_("Error: The value you entered was invalid."), err=err)
+                # The value is hidden, so it must not be leaked through the
+                # error message either. Mask occurrences of the value in its
+                # ``repr`` form, as produced by the built-in types, and fall
+                # back to a generic message if the raw value still appears in
+                # the message.
+                # Refs: https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/2809
+                masked = (e.message or "").replace(repr(value), "'***'")
+
+                if str(value) in masked:
+                    echo(_("Error: The value you entered was invalid."), err=err)
+                else:
+                    echo(_("Error: {message}").format(message=masked), err=err)
             else:
                 echo(_("Error: {e.message}").format(e=e), err=err)
             continue
